variables.name: JWT_ACCESS_SECRET
variables.description: Signing key for short-lived access tokens

variables.name: JWT_REFRESH_SECRET
variables.description: Signing key for refresh tokens; separate from the access key so leaking one cannot mint the other

variables.name: JWT_ACCESS_TTL
variables.description: Access token lifetime, as an ms/jsonwebtoken duration. Keep it short: a revoked user keeps their role until it expires

variables.name: JWT_REFRESH_TTL
variables.description: Refresh token lifetime; also the TTL on its database record

variables.name: AUTH_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Email of the admin account seeded on first boot

variables.name: AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the seeded admin account; change it after the first login
